rationale: diffusion_recon_dcstep_constrained_mayo_v4-claude-agentic: recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/ddpm_mayo_constrained_v4.pt, recon_mode=dps, recon_sample_steps=80, recon_eta=30.0, recon_init=fbp, recon_eta_clamp=False, recon_dcstep_every=5, recon_dcstep_n_cg=3, recon_dcstep_warmup=5, recon_dcstep_relax=1.0, recon_dc_solver=cg, val_n=70, train_n=0, rationale=iter-8 search-20260619-01 CONSTRAINED diff-recon — AUTHORIZED B-fix part (i) continued: push NFE one more step. ONE HYPOTHESIS KNOB: recon_sample_steps 60->80 (DDIM reverse-step count T); val_n 90->70 is the BUDGET-SIZING co-move (the authorized val_n exception per the B directive — metric evenly-spaces across the 214-slice L277 volume when val_n<214, 70>=~60 stays representative), NOT a second hypothesis. BASE = iter-7 BEST (recon_dc_solver=cg landed A-fix, T=60, eta=30, relax=1.0, every5/n_cg3/warmup5, val_n=90, SSIM 0.8396/hr0 — run-best). recon_dc_solver=cg HELD. TRAJECTORY (val=L277, 321px geometry FOV, LD-FBP floor ~0.81): iter-1 T=25 legacy 0.3937/hr0; iter-2 eta30->1 0.2366 (regressed, wrong lever); iter-3 relax1.0->0.3 0.2377 (flat, wrong lever); iter-4 T25->28 0.4784; iter-5 T28->40 (val214->120) 0.6647; iter-6 DC legacy->cg A-fix 0.7873; iter-7 T40->60 (val120->90) 0.8396 (BEST). KEY SIGNAL: NFE T is the ONLY live SSIM lever and it is STILL CLIMBING monotonically — T 25->28->40->60 lifted SSIM 0.394->0.478->0.665->0.840 on the corrected CG-DC path (iter-7 +0.052 over iter-6). The recon now sits 0.840, just past the ~0.81 FBP floor; a finer reverse grid (T=80) is the untested continuation of the one proven lever. FRAMING (per audit): this is REGIME-BOUNDED on DENSE 2304-view Mayo (LD-FBP near-complete at 2304 views) — a finer DDIM grid will NOT clear hr>0 here; the value of this iter is documenting the NFE->SSIM curve + validating the landed B-fix. The REAL PAYOFF is the 128-view SPARSE benchmarks + the planned EMA v5 prior. HYPOTHESIS: if the proven monotone T-lever continues, T=80 lifts SSIM above iter-7 0.8396. NUMERIC FALSIFIER: if SSIM <= 0.8396 (flat/below iter-7) at T=80, the NFE lever has SATURATED on dense Mayo -> B-fix part (i) validated FAITHFUL-BUT-REGIME-BOUNDED (finer grid does not help where LD-FBP is already near-complete; payoff awaits the sparse benchmarks + EMA v5 prior); constrained best stays iter-7 (SSIM 0.8396, hr 0). hr expected ~0 regardless (regime-bounded). BUDGET: cost linear in T x val_n; per-slice-per-step constant from the CG path = 0.2077 s (iter-7 1121.6s/90/60; iter-6 963.5s/120/40=0.2007, use the conservative iter-7 value). T=80 x val_n=70 = 80*70*0.2077 = 1163 s = 19.4 min < the HARD 1200s/20-min wall (1800s in-solver backstop + 30-min --time as further backstops). T=80 at val_n=90 would be 1495s=24.9min (BLOWS the wall); val_n=72 = 1196s=19.9min (too tight, no CG-variance headroom); val_n=70 gives ~37s headroom for the CG inner-loop variance and stays >=~60 (representative). A further NFE step (T=100) would force val_n<60 (too few slices) — so T=80 is the last representative NFE rung; if it saturates, the lever is exhausted. val=70 evenly-spaced L277, 321px detector-geometry FOV default (no fov=False). staged_canonical data, v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps single-val-ps probe, bg_target=truth, reuse ddpm_mayo_constrained_v4.pt (NO retrain), recon_dc_solver=cg (landed A-fix), 321px FOV.
